justification: Assessment reported INVALID and its counterexample is the same defect as ground truth: a 2-cycle ({u,v},{(u,v),(v,u)}) has a unique transitive reduction yet is cyclic, refuting the 'unique => acyclic' direction. Ground truth's witness is the identical 2-cycle a<->b targeting the same flaw ('unique transitive reduction only if acyclic'). Only vertex labels differ.
